prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve. This is the single final revision to a dialogue head portrait.
Input order: Image 1 is the first generated Lema portrait to RECOMPOSE AND REDRAW. Images 2-5 (Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore) are the coarse low-resolution STYLE AND LARGE-FACE/CLOSE-COLLAR standard.
Important correction: Image 1 has a long exposed neck and wide collar, a face too small relative to hair, overly bright eye whites, and tiny stubble speckles. Significantly enlarge the actual FACE and shorten the exposed neck. At the intended 74x100 grid, the chin should end around y=83, the visible neck is ONLY 3-4 pixels high, and a narrow collar strip fits y=89-95. Cheekbone face width about 48-50 pixels. Do not just zoom and crop the old image. Recompose the hair compactly so full tousled silhouette, all tufts and full ear stay clearly inside real 4px margins on all sides; head/hair crown should start around y=4. No missing source hair. No exposed long throat, no broad shoulders, no chest.
Identity invariants: Lema / 雷玛 is a narrow-shouldered pale man in his mid-to-late THIRTIES, not a handsome teenage adventurer. Preserve chestnut-brown tousled short hair with irregular fringe, straight nose, square lower jaw, faint short stubble, straight closed mouth, slightly uneven tense brows, restrained worried but firm gaze toward viewer left. Maintain pale skin with cooler muted ivory planes; avoid orange sun-tanned skin. At the bottom, show only a narrow washed-out oatmeal-gray coarse homespun smock collar and a tiny moss-green inner neckline. No heroic cape or costume jewelry.
Facial correction: SMALL HORIZONTAL DARK EYES with only one or two MUTED DARK WARM GRAY sclera pixels at target size, no white patches. Brow-to-cheek area must feel adult; mild under-eye tired planes, firm cheekbone and longer nose, lightly compressed mouth. Render faint stubble as a few joined angular shadow clusters, NOT individual dotted hairs. Enlarge connected forehead/nose/cheekbone planes. Keep distinction from Iwo/Tore; no full beard, no hat, no copied scars.
Style correction: emulate the coarse angular low-resolution reference structure in Images 2-5. Few large clean hard-edged color clusters, dark broken contour, roughly 24-32 intended colors total. No smooth gradients, tiny speckled texture, airbrushing, glossy eyes, anime face or portrait beauty retouching. One single isolated head portrait on genuine transparent alpha, binary-sharp outer edge, 74:100 canvas. No frame, text, labels, checkerboard, props, hands or completed gate/key/contract action. Preserve complete hair and ear contours without clipping.
